provenance_domain.name: Assay standard for the cardiac troponin I assay (TnI-Ultra, ADVIA Centaur XP)

review.reviewer_comment: Reviewed for analytical completeness. Fields marked PLACEHOLDER require the manufacturer's instructions for use before this specification can be applied.

usability_domain: Assay standard for the cardiac troponin I assay (TnI-Ultra, ADVIA Centaur XP).

Template BCO (tBCO): the specification for measuring one biomarker with one assay. States what is to be detected, how it is to be detected, the analytical limits within which a result is valid, when specimens are to be collected, and how a measured value is turned into a finding.
Analytical values are taken from the Supplementary Appendix of Keller T et al., N Engl J Med 2009;361:868-77 (PMID 19710485). Fields marked PLACEHOLDER are not stated in that source.

target.detects: Release of cardiac troponin I into the circulation following myocyte injury. An increase above the reference limit is the finding.

assay.regulatory_status: PLACEHOLDER - not stated in the study documents
assay.calibration_traceability: None. There is no certified primary reference material for cardiac troponin I and standardization across manufacturers is considered unlikely, because monoclonal antibodies to different cTnI epitopes recognise different circulating modifications. An IFCC working group is pursuing harmonization through a pooled serum-based secondary reference material. Results are traceable only to the manufacturer's own calibrator lineage.

specimen_requirements.handling: venipuncture into an SST; clot 30 min at room temperature; centrifuge at ~1500 x g for 10 min; separate serum into a labelled aliquot
specimen_requirements.stability: analyse within 24 h at 2-8 C; if delayed, store at <= -70 C and analyse within 30 days; avoid freeze-thaw cycles

subject_preconditions.rationale: diagnostic sensitivity depends on time since onset; a value within 3 h of onset is interpreted differently

sampling_schedule.rationale: a single admission value cannot distinguish acute release from chronic elevation; the rise or fall across serial samples is part of the finding

analytical_performance.linearity: accepted over the measuring range (CLSI EP06)
interferences: proteolytic degradation of the cTnI molecule
complexing of cTnI with cardiac troponin C
heterophile antibodies and human anti-mouse antibodies
PLACEHOLDER - interference thresholds and acceptance limits, from the manufacturer's instructions for use

derived_quantities.name: relative change
inputs: serial measurements within the delta window

interpretation_rules.expression: value > reference limit AND |relative change| >= threshold within window
interpretation_rules.display: Value > 0.04 ug/L AND rise or fall >= 30% within 6 h

interpretation_rules.outcome: adverse outcome (death, myocardial infarction or revascularisation) within 30 days

repeat_criteria.trigger: admission value between LoD and reference limit
repeat_criteria.rationale: PLACEHOLDER - not stated in the study documents

reporting_convention.censoring: values below the limit of detection are reported as '<LoD' with no numeric result; values between the LoD and the LLOQ keep their numeric value and are flagged detected_below_lloq; values above the ULOQ are reported as '>ULOQ'
reporting_convention.note: CDISC UNIT submission value ug/L; the laboratory reports the same unit as ng/mL.

pipeline_steps.name: collect_specimen
pipeline_steps.description: Collect the specimen described in specimen_requirements at each timepoint in sampling_schedule, after confirming subject_preconditions.

pipeline_steps.name: measure
pipeline_steps.description: Measure the analyte on the assay in assay_protocol_extension.assay. Flag results outside the measuring range per reporting_convention.

pipeline_steps.name: derive
pipeline_steps.description: Compute the quantities in derived_quantities from the serial values.

pipeline_steps.name: classify
pipeline_steps.description: Apply interpretation_rules to the measured and derived values and emit the finding.

empirical_error.imprecision_at_decision_limit: The 10% CV concentration (0.03 ug/L) lies below the 0.04 ug/L decision limit, so values near the limit carry about 10% analytical variability. A single marginal value is not definitive.
empirical_error.detection_floor: Values below 0.006 ug/L are not quantifiable and are left-censored.
empirical_error.physiological_confounders: Concentrations rise with age and falling renal function independently of acute injury.
empirical_error.reference_population_transferability: The limit derives from the named reference population; a different age or sex distribution shifts the false-positive rate.

algorithmic_error.assay_non_harmonization: Cardiac troponin I is not standardized across manufacturers and standardization is considered unlikely to be achievable, because antibodies to different epitopes recognise different circulating forms of the molecule. Every limit here is specific to the assay named in assay_protocol_extension.assay. For comparison, the Dimension RxL cTnI assay in the same study has a 99th percentile of 0.07 ng/mL against this assay's 0.04 ng/mL, with 20% CV at its own 99th percentile.
algorithmic_error.delta_threshold_is_assay_specific: The 30% threshold derives from this assay's imprecision, not from biology, and must be re-derived for any other assay.
algorithmic_error.unit_ambiguity_on_transfer: Limits are in ug/L (the CDISC submission value; the laboratory reports ng/mL, the same unit). A consuming system assuming ng/L misreads every one by a factor of 1000.
algorithmic_error.scope_limit: This object specifies how to measure and interpret, not whether the biomarker is valid for any purpose.
